var polygonArea = (polygon) => polygon.reduce((sum, point, i) => {
  const next = polygon[(i + 1) % polygon.length];
  return sum + point.x * next.z - next.x * point.z;
}, 0) / 2;
var polygonHasArea = (polygon) => polygon.length >= 3 && Math.abs(polygonArea(polygon)) > 1e-12;
var cross = (a, b, point) => (b.x - a.x) * (point.z - a.z) - (b.z - a.z) * (point.x - a.x);
var polygonBounds = (polygon) => ({
  minX: Math.min(...polygon.map((p) => p.x)),
  maxX: Math.max(...polygon.map((p) => p.x)),
  minZ: Math.min(...polygon.map((p) => p.z)),
  maxZ: Math.max(...polygon.map((p) => p.z))
});
var polygonBoxesOverlap = (a, b) => a.minX <= b.maxX && a.maxX >= b.minX && a.minZ <= b.maxZ && a.maxZ >= b.minZ;
function clipPolygon(polygon, distance3) {
  const result = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < polygon.length; i++) {
    const a = polygon[i], b = polygon[(i + 1) % polygon.length], da = distance3(a), db = distance3(b);
    if (da >= 0) result.push(a);
    if (da >= 0 !== db >= 0) {
      const t = da / (da - db);
      result.push({ x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, z: a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t });
    }
  }
  return result;
}
function intersectPolygons(polygon, convex) {
  let result = [...polygon];
  const orientation = Math.sign(polygonArea(convex));
  for (let i = 0; i < convex.length && polygonHasArea(result); i++) {
    const a = convex[i], b = convex[(i + 1) % convex.length];
    result = clipPolygon(result, (p) => orientation * cross(a, b, p));
  }
  return result;
}
function subtractPolygon(polygon, convex) {
  const result = [], orientation = Math.sign(polygonArea(convex));
  let inside = [...polygon];
  for (let i = 0; i < convex.length && polygonHasArea(inside); i++) {
    const a = convex[i], b = convex[(i + 1) % convex.length], distance3 = (p) => orientation * cross(a, b, p);
    const outside = clipPolygon(inside, (p) => -distance3(p));
    if (polygonHasArea(outside)) result.push(outside);
    inside = clipPolygon(inside, distance3);
  }
  return result;
}
function triangulateWaterPolygon(input) {
  if (input.length < 3 || input.some((p) => !Number.isFinite(p.x) || !Number.isFinite(p.z))) return;
  let points = input.filter((p, i) => Math.hypot(p.x - input[(i + input.length - 1) % input.length].x, p.z - input[(i + input.length - 1) % input.length].z) > 1e-10);
  for (let i = points.length - 1; i >= 0 && points.length >= 3; i--) {
    if (Math.abs(cross(points[(i + points.length - 1) % points.length], points[(i + 1) % points.length], points[i])) <= 1e-12) points.splice(i, 1);
  }
  if (!polygonHasArea(points)) return;
  const onSegment = (a, b, p) => Math.abs(cross(a, b, p)) <= 1e-12 && p.x >= Math.min(a.x, b.x) - 1e-12 && p.x <= Math.max(a.x, b.x) + 1e-12 && p.z >= Math.min(a.z, b.z) - 1e-12 && p.z <= Math.max(a.z, b.z) + 1e-12;
  for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < points.length; j++) {
    if (j === i + 1 || i === 0 && j === points.length - 1) continue;
    const a = points[i], b = points[(i + 1) % points.length], c = points[j], d = points[(j + 1) % points.length];
    if (cross(a, b, c) * cross(a, b, d) < 0 && cross(c, d, a) * cross(c, d, b) < 0 || onSegment(a, b, c) || onSegment(a, b, d) || onSegment(c, d, a) || onSegment(c, d, b)) return;
  }
  const result = [], orientation = Math.sign(polygonArea(points));
  points = [...points];
  while (points.length > 3) {
    const ear = points.findIndex((b, i) => {
      const a = points[(i + points.length - 1) % points.length], c = points[(i + 1) % points.length];
      return orientation * cross(a, b, c) > 1e-12 && !points.some((p, j) => j !== i && j !== (i + points.length - 1) % points.length && j !== (i + 1) % points.length && orientation * cross(a, b, p) >= -1e-12 && orientation * cross(b, c, p) >= -1e-12 && orientation * cross(c, a, p) >= -1e-12);
    });
    if (ear < 0) return;
    result.push([points[(ear + points.length - 1) % points.length], points[ear], points[(ear + 1) % points.length]]);
    points.splice(ear, 1);
  }
  result.push(points);
  return result;
}
function mapTrianglePoint(point, from, to) {
  const [a, b, c] = from, determinant = (b.z - c.z) * (a.x - c.x) + (c.x - b.x) * (a.z - c.z);
  const u = ((b.z - c.z) * (point.x - c.x) + (c.x - b.x) * (point.z - c.z)) / determinant;
  const v = ((c.z - a.z) * (point.x - c.x) + (a.x - c.x) * (point.z - c.z)) / determinant;
  return { x: to[0].x * u + to[1].x * v + to[2].x * (1 - u - v), z: to[0].z * u + to[1].z * v + to[2].z * (1 - u - v) };
}
var protectionRectangle = (cell, half2) => [
  { x: cell.x - half2, z: cell.z - half2 },
  { x: cell.x + half2, z: cell.z - half2 },
  { x: cell.x + half2, z: cell.z + half2 },
  { x: cell.x - half2, z: cell.z + half2 }
];

var AUTHORED_OWNER_HALF_EXTENT = 0.46;
var AUTHORED_WALK_HALF_WIDTH = 0.12;
var clearance = AUTHORED_OWNER_HALF_EXTENT + AUTHORED_WALK_HALF_WIDTH;
var cellKey = (cell) => `${cell.x},${cell.z}`;
var shoreIndexes = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap();
var walkKeys = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap();
var SHORE_DISTANCE = 0.65;
var MAX_SHORE_ANSWERS = 16384;
function shoreIndex(floors) {
  const existing = shoreIndexes.get(floors);
  if (existing) return existing;
  const index = { buckets: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), waterBuckets: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), waterFloors: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), footAnswers: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), waterDistances: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map() };
  let order = 0;
  for (const floor of floors) {
    if (floor.kind === "water") index.waterFloors.set(floor.id, polygonBounds(floor.vertices.map((vertex) => vertex.point)));
    for (let i = 0; i < floor.indices.length; i += 3) {
      const points = floor.indices.slice(i, i + 3).map((id) => floor.vertices[id].point), box = polygonBounds(points);
      const triangle = { floorId: floor.id, water: floor.kind === "water", points, box, order: order++ };
      for (let z = Math.floor(box.minZ); z <= Math.floor(box.maxZ); z++) for (let x = Math.floor(box.minX); x <= Math.floor(box.maxX); x++) {
        const id = cellKey({ x, z }), list = index.buckets.get(id) ?? [];
        list.push(triangle);
        index.buckets.set(id, list);
        if (triangle.water) {
          const water = index.waterBuckets.get(id) ?? [];
          water.push(triangle);
          index.waterBuckets.set(id, water);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  shoreIndexes.set(floors, index);
  return index;
}
function shoreTriangles(buckets, point, radius) {
  const triangles = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (let z = Math.floor(point.z - radius); z <= Math.floor(point.z + radius); z++) for (let x = Math.floor(point.x - radius); x <= Math.floor(point.x + radius); x++)
    for (const triangle of buckets.get(cellKey({ x, z })) ?? []) if (triangle.box.minX <= point.x + radius && triangle.box.maxX >= point.x - radius && triangle.box.minZ <= point.z + radius && triangle.box.maxZ >= point.z - radius) triangles.add(triangle);
  return [...triangles];
}
function waterDistance(point, triangle) {
  const crosses = triangle.points.map((a, i) => {
    const b = triangle.points[(i + 1) % triangle.points.length];
    return (b.x - a.x) * (point.z - a.z) - (b.z - a.z) * (point.x - a.x);
  });
  if (crosses.every((value) => value >= -1e-12) || crosses.every((value) => value <= 1e-12)) return 0;
  return Math.min(...triangle.points.map((a, i) => {
    const b = triangle.points[(i + 1) % triangle.points.length], dx = b.x - a.x, dz = b.z - a.z;
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((point.x - a.x) * dx + (point.z - a.z) * dz) / (dx * dx + dz * dz)));
    return Math.hypot(point.x - a.x - dx * t, point.z - a.z - dz * t);
  }));
}
function shoreHeight(triangle, point) {
  return mapTrianglePoint(point, triangle.points, triangle.points.map((p) => ({ x: p.y, z: 0 }))).x;
}
function hasWalkRef(world, cell) {
  if (!Object.isFrozen(world.walkSites)) return world.walkSites.some((site) => cellKey(site.cell) === cellKey(cell));
  let keys = walkKeys.get(world.walkSites);
  if (!keys) {
    keys = new Set(world.walkSites.map((site) => cellKey(site.cell)));
    walkKeys.set(world.walkSites, keys);
  }
  return keys.has(cellKey(cell));
}
function distancesAt(index, point) {
  const id = cellKey(point), existing = index.waterDistances.get(id);
  if (existing) return existing;
  const distances = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const triangle of shoreTriangles(index.waterBuckets, point, SHORE_DISTANCE)) {
    const distance3 = waterDistance(point, triangle), previous = distances.get(triangle.floorId) ?? Infinity;
    distances.set(triangle.floorId, Math.min(previous, distance3));
  }
  if (index.waterDistances.size >= MAX_SHORE_ANSWERS) index.waterDistances.clear();
  index.waterDistances.set(id, distances);
  return distances;
}
function subtractShoreCover(polygon, cover, orientation) {
  for (let i = 0; i < cover.length; i++) {
    const a = cover[i], b = cover[(i + 1) % cover.length];
    let inside = true, outside = true;
    for (const p of polygon) {
      const distance3 = orientation * ((b.x - a.x) * (p.z - a.z) - (b.z - a.z) * (p.x - a.x));
      inside &&= distance3 > 0;
      outside &&= distance3 < 0;
      if (!inside && !outside) break;
    }
    if (inside) continue;
    if (outside) return [polygon];
    return subtractPolygon(polygon, cover);
  }
  return [];
}
function footSupported(index, point) {
  const id = `${point.x},${point.y},${point.z}`, existing = index.footAnswers.get(id);
  if (existing !== void 0) return existing;
  const square = protectionRectangle(point, AUTHORED_WALK_HALF_WIDTH);
  const triangles = shoreTriangles(index.buckets, point, AUTHORED_WALK_HALF_WIDTH);
  const minX = Math.floor(point.x - SHORE_DISTANCE), minZ = Math.floor(point.z - SHORE_DISTANCE);
  triangles.sort((a, b) => Math.max(minZ, Math.floor(a.box.minZ)) - Math.max(minZ, Math.floor(b.box.minZ)) || Math.max(minX, Math.floor(a.box.minX)) - Math.max(minX, Math.floor(b.box.minX)) || a.order - b.order);
  const overlaps3 = [];
  let answer = true;
  for (const triangle of triangles) {
    const overlap = intersectPolygons(square, triangle.points);
    if (!polygonHasArea(overlap)) continue;
    if (triangle.water || polygonHasArea(clipPolygon(overlap, (p) => shoreHeight(triangle, p) - point.y - 0.25 - 1e-7))) {
      answer = false;
      break;
    }
    overlaps3.push({ triangle, overlap });
  }
  if (answer) {
    let uncovered = [square];
    for (const { triangle, overlap } of overlaps3) {
      let cover = clipPolygon(overlap, (p) => shoreHeight(triangle, p) - point.y + 0.25 + 1e-7);
      cover = clipPolygon(cover, (p) => point.y + 0.25 + 1e-7 - shoreHeight(triangle, p));
      if (polygonHasArea(cover)) {
        const orientation = Math.sign(polygonArea(cover));
        uncovered = uncovered.flatMap((piece) => subtractShoreCover(piece, cover, orientation));
      }
      if (!uncovered.length) break;
    }
    answer = !uncovered.length;
  }
  if (index.footAnswers.size >= MAX_SHORE_ANSWERS) index.footAnswers.clear();
  index.footAnswers.set(id, answer);
  return answer;
}
function isAuthoredShoreEntrySupported(world, cell, waterFloorIds) {
  if (!hasWalkRef(world, cell)) return false;
  const support = world.floorAt(cell), original = world.anchorFloorAt(cell);
  if (!support || !original || Math.hypot(support.point.x - original.point.x, support.point.z - original.point.z) > 1e-5 || Math.abs(support.point.y - original.point.y) > 0.28) return false;
  const index = shoreIndex(world.floors);
  if (!waterFloorIds.length || waterFloorIds.some((id) => !index.waterFloors.has(id))) return false;
  const distances = distancesAt(index, support.point);
  const distance3 = Math.min(...waterFloorIds.map((id) => distances.get(id) ?? Infinity));
  return distance3 > AUTHORED_WALK_HALF_WIDTH * Math.SQRT2 && distance3 <= SHORE_DISTANCE && footSupported(index, support.point);
}
function findAuthoredShoreEntries(world, waterFloorIds) {
  const index = shoreIndex(world.floors), bounds2 = waterFloorIds.flatMap((id) => {
    const box = index.waterFloors.get(id);
    return box ? [box] : [];
  });
  if (!bounds2.length) return [];
  return world.walkSites.filter((site) => bounds2.some((box) => site.support.point.x >= box.minX - SHORE_DISTANCE && site.support.point.x <= box.maxX + SHORE_DISTANCE && site.support.point.z >= box.minZ - SHORE_DISTANCE && site.support.point.z <= box.maxZ + SHORE_DISTANCE) && isAuthoredShoreEntrySupported(world, site.cell, waterFloorIds)).sort((a, b) => a.cell.z - b.cell.z || a.cell.x - b.cell.x).map((site) => ({ ...site.ref }));
}

var EPSILON = 1e-7;
var stable = (value) => Math.round(value * 1e9) / 1e9 || 0;

var refKey = (ref) => JSON.stringify([ref.districtId, ref.siteId]);
var floorKey = (districtId, floorId2) => JSON.stringify([districtId, floorId2]);
var turn = (x, z, count) => count === 1 ? { x: -z, z: x } : count === 2 ? { x: -x, z: -z } : count === 3 ? { x: z, z: -x } : { x, z };
function requireWorld(valid, message) {
  if (!valid) throw new Error(`Invalid island world: ${message}`);
}
function freeze(value) {
  if (value && typeof value === "object" && !Object.isFrozen(value)) {
    Object.values(value).forEach(freeze);
    Object.freeze(value);
  }
  return value;
}
var FINE_DIVISIONS = 16;
var FINE_THRESHOLD = 64;

function barycentric(at, a, b, c) {
  const determinant = (b.z - c.z) * (a.x - c.x) + (c.x - b.x) * (a.z - c.z);
  if (Math.abs(determinant) <= 1e-12) return void 0;
  const u = ((b.z - c.z) * (at.x - c.x) + (c.x - b.x) * (at.z - c.z)) / determinant;
  const v = ((c.z - a.z) * (at.x - c.x) + (a.x - c.x) * (at.z - c.z)) / determinant;
  const w = 1 - u - v;
  return u >= -EPSILON && v >= -EPSILON && w >= -EPSILON ? [u, v, w] : void 0;
}
var interpolate = (points, weights) => ({
  x: stable(points.reduce((value, point, i) => value + point.x * weights[i], 0)),
  y: stable(points.reduce((value, point, i) => value + point.y * weights[i], 0)),
  z: stable(points.reduce((value, point, i) => value + point.z * weights[i], 0))
});
function walkEdgeError(from, to, floorAt) {
  if (!from?.support || !to?.support) return "walk edge endpoint has no actual dry floor";
  const dx = to.cell.x - from.cell.x, dz = to.cell.z - from.cell.z, length = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
  if (!(length > 0 && length <= 256)) return "walk edge length";
  const steps = Math.max(8, Math.ceil(length * 8));
  const physicalStep = Math.hypot(to.support.point.x - from.support.point.x, to.support.point.z - from.support.point.z) / steps * 2 + 0.15;
  let previous;
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
    for (const side of [-0.12, 0, 0.12]) {
      const cell = { x: from.cell.x + dx * i / steps - dz / length * side, z: from.cell.z + dz * i / steps + dx / length * side };
      const floor = floorAt(cell);
      if (!floor) return "walk edge crosses missing floor or water";
      if (side !== 0) continue;
      if (previous) {
        if (Math.abs(floor.point.y - previous.y) > 0.25) return "walk edge has an unsupported vertical step";
        if (Math.hypot(floor.point.x - previous.x, floor.point.z - previous.z) > physicalStep) return "walk edge crosses separated physical floors";
      }
      const endpoint = i === 0 ? from.support : i === steps ? to.support : void 0;
      if (endpoint && Math.hypot(floor.point.x - endpoint.point.x, floor.point.y - endpoint.point.y, floor.point.z - endpoint.point.z) >= 0.025)
        return "walk endpoint differs from its site floor";
      previous = floor.point;
    }
  }
}
function compileWorldDefinition(input) {
  requireWorld(input.version === 1 && typeof input.id === "string" && input.id.length > 0, "unknown version or missing ID");
  requireWorld(input.revision === void 0 || typeof input.revision === "string" && input.revision.length > 0, "geometry revision");
  requireWorld(Array.isArray(input.districts) && Array.isArray(input.edges), "districts or edges");
  if (input.source) requireWorld(input.source.artifact && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(input.source.sha256), "source identity");
  const definition2 = structuredClone(input);
  const triangles = [], anchorTriangles = [], originalTriangles = [];
  const floors = [], anchorFloors = [], sites = [], surfaces = [];
  const districtIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), allFloors = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), allAnchorFloors = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), allSurfaces = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  const refs = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), cells = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const finite = (point) => Number.isFinite(point.x) && Number.isFinite(point.z) && (!("y" in point) || Number.isFinite(point.y));
  const unit = (value) => Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 1;
  const logicalPoint = (district, cell) => {
    const p = turn(cell.x, cell.z, district.turn);
    return { x: p.x + district.logicalOrigin.x, z: p.z + district.logicalOrigin.z };
  };
  const worldPoint2 = (district, point) => {
    const p = turn(point.x, point.z, district.turn);
    return { x: p.x + district.worldOrigin.x, y: point.y + district.worldOrigin.y, z: p.z + district.worldOrigin.z };
  };
  for (const district of definition2.districts) {
    requireWorld(district.id && !districtIds.has(district.id), "duplicate district");
    districtIds.add(district.id);
    requireWorld(finite(district.logicalOrigin) && Number.isInteger(district.logicalOrigin.x) && Number.isInteger(district.logicalOrigin.z) && finite(district.worldOrigin) && Number.isFinite(district.worldOrigin.y) && [0, 1, 2, 3].includes(district.turn), "district origin or turn");
    requireWorld(district.waterCarvingScopes === void 0 || Array.isArray(district.waterCarvingScopes), "water carving scopes");
    const scopeIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), originals = district.anchorFloors?.length ? district.anchorFloors : district.floors;
    for (const scope of district.waterCarvingScopes ?? []) {
      requireWorld(typeof scope.id === "string" && scope.id.length && !scopeIds.has(scope.id), "duplicate or missing water carving scope");
      scopeIds.add(scope.id);
      requireWorld(Array.isArray(scope.floorIds) && scope.floorIds.length && new Set(scope.floorIds).size === scope.floorIds.length && scope.floorIds.every((id) => originals.some((floor) => floor.id === id && floor.kind === "ground")), "water carving original ground");
      requireWorld(Array.isArray(scope.envelope) && triangulateWaterPolygon(scope.envelope), "water carving envelope");
      const orientation = Math.sign(polygonArea(scope.envelope));
      requireWorld(scope.envelope.every((a, i) => {
        const b = scope.envelope[(i + 1) % scope.envelope.length], c = scope.envelope[(i + 2) % scope.envelope.length];
        return orientation * ((b.x - a.x) * (c.z - b.z) - (b.z - a.z) * (c.x - b.x)) >= -1e-12;
      }), "water carving envelope must be convex");
    }
    const compileFloor = (floor, anchor) => {
      const id = floorKey(district.id, floor.id);
      const ids = anchor ? allAnchorFloors : allFloors;
      requireWorld(floor.id && !ids.has(id), "duplicate floor");
      ids.add(id);
      requireWorld(["ground", "deck", "water"].includes(floor.kind) && floor.indices.length > 0 && floor.indices.length % 3 === 0, "floor kind or indices");
      requireWorld(/^#[a-fA-F0-9]{6}$/.test(floor.color), "floor color");
      if (floor.material !== void 0) requireWorld(floor.material && unit(floor.material.roughness) && unit(floor.material.metalness) && typeof floor.material.doubleSided === "boolean", "floor material");
      const vertices = floor.vertices.map((vertex) => {
        requireWorld(finite(vertex.cell) && finite(vertex.point) && Number.isFinite(vertex.point.y), "non-finite floor vertex");
        const normal = vertex.normal;
        if (normal !== void 0) requireWorld(normal && finite(normal) && Number.isFinite(normal.y) && Math.hypot(normal.x, normal.y, normal.z) > 1e-12, "floor normal");
        const rotated = normal ? turn(normal.x, normal.z, district.turn) : void 0;
        return {
          cell: logicalPoint(district, vertex.cell),
          point: worldPoint2(district, vertex.point),
          ...normal && rotated ? { normal: { x: rotated.x, y: normal.y, z: rotated.z } } : {}
        };
      });
      for (const index of floor.indices) requireWorld(Number.isInteger(index) && index >= 0 && index < vertices.length, "floor index out of range");
      for (let i = 0; i < floor.indices.length; i += 3) {
        const v = floor.indices.slice(i, i + 3).map((index) => vertices[index]);
        const area4 = (points2) => Math.abs((points2[1].x - points2[0].x) * (points2[2].z - points2[0].z) - (points2[2].x - points2[0].x) * (points2[1].z - points2[0].z));
        requireWorld(area4(v.map((vertex) => vertex.cell)) > 1e-12 && area4(v.map((vertex) => vertex.point)) > 1e-12, "collapsed floor triangle");
        const triangle = {
          floorId: id,
          kind: floor.kind,
          cells: v.map((vertex) => vertex.cell),
          points: v.map((vertex) => vertex.point)
        };
        (anchor ? anchorTriangles : triangles).push(triangle);
        if (anchor || !district.anchorFloors?.length) originalTriangles.push(triangle);
      }
      (anchor ? anchorFloors : floors).push({
        id,
        kind: floor.kind,
        color: floor.color,
        vertices,
        indices: [...floor.indices],
        ...floor.material ? { material: { ...floor.material } } : {}
      });
    };
    for (const floor of district.floors) compileFloor(floor, false);
    for (const floor of district.anchorFloors ?? []) compileFloor(floor, true);

var distance = (a, b) => Math.abs(a.x - b.x) + Math.abs(a.z - b.z);
var MAX_CHANNEL_STEPS = 8;
var directions = [{ x: 0, z: -1, bit: 1 }, { x: 1, z: 0, bit: 2 }, { x: 0, z: 1, bit: 4 }, { x: -1, z: 0, bit: 8 }];
var waterNeighbors = (state, cell) => (state.neighbors?.(cell) ?? directions.map(({ x, z }) => ({ x: cell.x + x, z: cell.z + z }))).filter((next) => Number.isInteger(cell.x) && Number.isInteger(cell.z) && Number.isInteger(next.x) && Number.isInteger(next.z) && distance(cell, next) === 1);
function connectedWaterChannels(state) {
  const channels = new Map(state.items.filter((item) => item.kind === "water-channel" && item.cell).map((item) => [cellKey3(item.cell), item]));
  const bowls = state.items.filter((item) => item.kind === "water-bowl" && item.cell);
  const reached = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  let frontier = [...channels.entries()].filter(([key5, item]) => {
    if (!item.cell || !bowls.some((bowl) => waterNeighbors(state, bowl.cell).some((next) => cellKey3(next) === key5))) return false;
    reached.add(key5);
    return true;
  }).map(([key5]) => key5);
  for (let step = 1; step < MAX_CHANNEL_STEPS && frontier.length; step++) {
    const next = [];
    for (const key5 of frontier) {
      const item = channels.get(key5);
      for (const nextCell of waterNeighbors(state, item.cell)) {
        const neighbor = cellKey3(nextCell);
        if (channels.has(neighbor) && !reached.has(neighbor)) {
          reached.add(neighbor);
          next.push(neighbor);
        }
      }
    }
    frontier = next;
  }
  return reached;
}

function landBounds2({ land }) {
  const sides = [land.expanded, ...land.extra];
  const west = sides.includes("west"), east = sides.includes("east");
  const districts = land.districts ?? [];
  return {
    minX: (land.capes.includes("west") ? -6 : west ? -3 : 0) - 3 * districts.filter((s) => s === "west").length,
    maxX: (land.capes.includes("east") ? 11 : east ? 8 : 5) + 3 * districts.filter((s) => s === "east").length,
    depth: (sides.includes("south") ? 8 : 5) + 3 * districts.filter((s) => s === "south").length
  };
}
function onLand(state, cell, world) {
  if (world) return world.owns(cell);
  const { minX, maxX, depth } = landBounds2(state);
  return Number.isInteger(cell.x) && Number.isInteger(cell.z) && cell.x >= minX && cell.x <= maxX && cell.z >= 0 && cell.z < depth;
}

    ...world ? { neighbors: (cell) => world.neighbors(cell, "water") } : {}
  };
}

function sourceIndex(base2, districtId) {

  if (!districts) {
    districts = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();

  }
  const existing = districts.get(districtId);
  if (existing) return existing;
  const buckets = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), district = base2.definition.districts.find((district2) => district2.id === districtId);
  const index = { buckets, identity: true };
  if (!district) return index;
  const sourceFloors = district.anchorFloors?.length ? base2.anchorFloors : base2.floors;
  const scopes = district.waterCarvingScopes;
  const strictRectangles = base2.sites.filter((site) => site.placement && site.ref.districtId === districtId).map((site) => protectionRectangle(site.cell, 0.5));
  for (const floor of sourceFloors) {
    if (floor.kind !== "ground" || JSON.parse(floor.id)[0] !== districtId) continue;
    const regions = scopes?.length ? scopes.filter((scope) => scope.floorIds.some((id) => compiledId(districtId, id) === floor.id)).map((scope) => logicalEnvelope(district, scope.envelope)) : strictRectangles;
    if (!regions.length) continue;
    index.identity &&= floor.vertices.every((vertex) => vertex.cell.x === vertex.point.x && vertex.cell.z === vertex.point.z);
    const regionBoxes = regions.map(polygonBounds);
    for (let i = 0; i < floor.indices.length; i += 3) {
      const vertices = floor.indices.slice(i, i + 3).map((id) => floor.vertices[id]), cells = vertices.map((vertex) => vertex.cell), points = vertices.map((vertex) => vertex.point);
      const logicalBox = polygonBounds(cells);
      for (let r = 0; r < regions.length; r++) {
        if (!polygonBoxesOverlap(logicalBox, regionBoxes[r])) continue;
        const logical = intersectPolygons(cells, regions[r]);
        if (!polygonHasArea(logical)) continue;
        const polygon = logical.map((cell) => mapTrianglePoint(cell, cells, points)), box = polygonBounds(polygon);
        const cover = { cells, points, polygon, box, logicalBox };
        for (let z = Math.floor(box.minZ); z <= Math.floor(box.maxZ); z++) for (let x = Math.floor(box.minX); x <= Math.floor(box.maxX); x++) {
          const id = key2(x, z), list = buckets.get(id) ?? [];
          list.push(cover);
          buckets.set(id, list);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  districts.set(districtId, index);
  return index;
}
function candidatesIn(index, box) {
  const candidates = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (let z = Math.floor(box.minZ); z <= Math.floor(box.maxZ); z++) for (let x = Math.floor(box.minX); x <= Math.floor(box.maxX); x++)
    for (const source of index.buckets.get(key2(x, z)) ?? []) if (polygonBoxesOverlap(box, source.box)) candidates.add(source);
  return candidates;
}
function isAuthoredWaterCarvingSafe(base2, districtId, outline, protections2) {
  if (outline.some((point) => !Number.isFinite(point.y)) || protections2.some((p) => !Number.isFinite(p.cell.x) || !Number.isFinite(p.cell.z) || !Number.isFinite(p.half) || p.half <= 0)) return false;
  const triangles = triangulateWaterPolygon(outline);
  if (!triangles) return false;
  if (triangles.some((triangle) => {
    const box = polygonBounds(triangle);
    return ![box.minX, box.maxX, box.minZ, box.maxZ].every((value) => Number.isSafeInteger(Math.floor(value))) || (Math.floor(box.maxX) - Math.floor(box.minX) + 1) * (Math.floor(box.maxZ) - Math.floor(box.minZ) + 1) > 1e5;
  })) return false;
  const index = sourceIndex(base2, districtId), protectedRegions = protections2.map((p) => ({ polygon: protectionRectangle(p.cell, p.half), box: polygonBounds(protectionRectangle(p.cell, p.half)) }));
  if (index.identity) {
    for (const triangle of triangles) {
      const box = polygonBounds(triangle);
      for (const protection of protectedRegions) {
        if (!polygonBoxesOverlap(box, protection.box)) continue;
        const joint = {
          minX: Math.max(box.minX, protection.box.minX),
          maxX: Math.min(box.maxX, protection.box.maxX),
          minZ: Math.max(box.minZ, protection.box.minZ),
          maxZ: Math.min(box.maxZ, protection.box.maxZ)
        };
        for (const source of candidatesIn(index, joint)) {
          if (!polygonBoxesOverlap(source.logicalBox, protection.box)) continue;
          const overlap = intersectPolygons(triangle, source.polygon);
          if (!polygonHasArea(overlap)) continue;
          const logical = overlap.map((point) => mapTrianglePoint(point, source.points, source.cells));
          if (polygonHasArea(intersectPolygons(logical, protection.polygon))) return false;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  for (const triangle of triangles) {
    const box = polygonBounds(triangle);
    let uncovered = [{ polygon: triangle, box }];
    for (const source of candidatesIn(index, box)) {
      if (index.identity && !uncovered.some((piece) => polygonBoxesOverlap(piece.box, source.box))) continue;
      const overlap = intersectPolygons(triangle, source.polygon);
      if (!polygonHasArea(overlap)) continue;
      if (!index.identity) {
        const logical = overlap.map((point) => mapTrianglePoint(point, source.points, source.cells));
        if (protectedRegions.some((p) => polygonBoxesOverlap(source.logicalBox, p.box) && polygonHasArea(intersectPolygons(logical, p.polygon)))) return false;
      }
      uncovered = uncovered.flatMap((piece) => polygonBoxesOverlap(piece.box, source.box) ? subtractPolygon(piece.polygon, source.polygon).map((polygon) => ({ polygon, box: polygonBounds(polygon) })) : [piece]);
      if (index.identity && !uncovered.length) break;
    }
    if (uncovered.length) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

// ../../../../private/tmp/sansu-authored-shoulder-c2/candidate/src/domain/growingIsland/authoredWaterContour.ts
var EPS = 1e-9;
var cross2 = (a, b, c) => (b.x - a.x) * (c.z - a.z) - (b.z - a.z) * (c.x - a.x);
var same = (a, b) => Math.abs(a.x - b.x) < EPS && Math.abs(a.z - b.z) < EPS;
var outlineArea = (outline) => outline.reduce((sum, p, i) => {
  const q = outline[(i + 1) % outline.length];
  return sum + p.x * q.z - p.z * q.x;
}, 0) / 2;
function pointInWaterOutline(point, outline) {
  let inside = false;
  for (let i = 0, j = outline.length - 1; i < outline.length; j = i++) {
    const a = outline[j], b = outline[i], length = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z);
    if (length > EPS && Math.abs(cross2(a, b, point)) <= EPS * length && point.x >= Math.min(a.x, b.x) - EPS && point.x <= Math.max(a.x, b.x) + EPS && point.z >= Math.min(a.z, b.z) - EPS && point.z <= Math.max(a.z, b.z) + EPS) return true;
    if (a.z > point.z !== b.z > point.z && point.x < (b.x - a.x) * (point.z - a.z) / (b.z - a.z) + a.x) inside = !inside;
  }
  return inside;
}
var isConvex = (p) => p.every((a, i) => cross2(a, p[(i + 1) % p.length], p[(i + 2) % p.length]) >= -EPS);
function decomposeWaterOutline(outline) {
  if (outline.length < 3 || outline.length > 128 || !outline.every((p) => [p.x, p.y, p.z].every(Number.isFinite))) return [];
  const vertices = [...outlineArea(outline) < 0 ? [...outline].reverse() : outline];
  const pieces = [];
  while (vertices.length > 3) {
    let clipped = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < vertices.length; i++) {
      const a = vertices[(i + vertices.length - 1) % vertices.length], b = vertices[i], c = vertices[(i + 1) % vertices.length];
      if (cross2(a, b, c) <= EPS) continue;
      if (vertices.some((p) => p !== a && p !== b && p !== c && cross2(a, b, p) >= -EPS && cross2(b, c, p) >= -EPS && cross2(c, a, p) >= -EPS)) continue;
      pieces.push([a, b, c]);
      vertices.splice(i, 1);
      clipped = true;
      break;
    }
    if (!clipped) return [];
  }
  if (outlineArea(vertices) <= EPS) return [];
  pieces.push(vertices);
  for (let changed = true; changed; ) {
    changed = false;
    merge: for (let a = 0; a < pieces.length; a++) for (let b = a + 1; b < pieces.length; b++) {
      const left = pieces[a], right = pieces[b];
      for (let i = 0; i < left.length; i++) for (let j = 0; j < right.length; j++) {
        if (!same(left[i], right[(j + 1) % right.length]) || !same(left[(i + 1) % left.length], right[j])) continue;
        const joined = [
          ...Array.from({ length: left.length }, (_, k) => left[(i + 1 + k) % left.length]),
          ...Array.from({ length: right.length - 2 }, (_, k) => right[(j + 2 + k) % right.length])
        ];
        if (!isConvex(joined)) continue;
        pieces[a] = joined;
        pieces.splice(b, 1);
        changed = true;
        break merge;
      }
    }
  }
  return pieces;
}
function waterRayExit(origin, dx, dz, outline) {
  if (!pointInWaterOutline(origin, outline)) return;
  let nearest = Infinity;
  for (let i = 0; i < outline.length; i++) {
    const a = outline[i], b = outline[(i + 1) % outline.length], ex = b.x - a.x, ez = b.z - a.z;
    const determinant = dx * ez - dz * ex;
    if (Math.abs(determinant) < EPS) continue;
    const ax = a.x - origin.x, az = a.z - origin.z, t = (ax * ez - az * ex) / determinant, u = (ax * dz - az * dx) / determinant;
    if (t >= -EPS && u >= -EPS && u <= 1 + EPS) nearest = Math.min(nearest, t);
  }
  return Number.isFinite(nearest) ? nearest : void 0;
}
function waterSegmentIntervals(a, b, outline) {
  const dx = b.x - a.x, dz = b.z - a.z, values = [0, 1];
  for (let i = 0; i < outline.length; i++) {
    const p = outline[i], q = outline[(i + 1) % outline.length], ex = q.x - p.x, ez = q.z - p.z, det = dx * ez - dz * ex;
    if (Math.abs(det) < EPS) continue;
    const px = p.x - a.x, pz = p.z - a.z, t = (px * ez - pz * ex) / det, u = (px * dz - pz * dx) / det;
    if (t > EPS && t < 1 - EPS && u >= -EPS && u <= 1 + EPS) values.push(t);
  }
  values.sort((x, y) => x - y);
  return values.slice(1).flatMap((end, i) => {
    const start = values[i], t = (start + end) / 2;
    return end - start > EPS && pointInWaterOutline({ x: a.x + dx * t, y: a.y, z: a.z + dz * t }, outline) ? [[start, end]] : [];
  });
}
function subtractWaterConvexPieces(polygon, pieces) {
  let remaining = [[...polygon]];
  const box = (points) => ({
    minX: Math.min(...points.map((p) => p.x)),
    maxX: Math.max(...points.map((p) => p.x)),
    minZ: Math.min(...points.map((p) => p.z)),
    maxZ: Math.max(...points.map((p) => p.z))
  });
  const sourceBox = box(polygon);
  for (const piece of pieces) {
    const cutBox = box(piece);
    if (sourceBox.maxX < cutBox.minX - EPS || sourceBox.minX > cutBox.maxX + EPS || sourceBox.maxZ < cutBox.minZ - EPS || sourceBox.minZ > cutBox.maxZ + EPS) continue;
    remaining = remaining.flatMap((input) => {
      let inside = input;
      const outside = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < piece.length && inside.length; i++) {
        const a = piece[i], b = piece[(i + 1) % piece.length];
        const split = (keepInside) => {
          const result = [];
          for (let j = 0; j < inside.length; j++) {
            const p = inside[j], q = inside[(j + 1) % inside.length], dp = cross2(a, b, p), dq = cross2(a, b, q);
            const keepP = keepInside ? dp >= -EPS : dp <= EPS, keepQ = keepInside ? dq >= -EPS : dq <= EPS;
            if (keepP) result.push(p);
            if (keepP !== keepQ && Math.abs(dp - dq) > EPS) {
              const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, dp / (dp - dq)));
              result.push({ x: p.x + (q.x - p.x) * t, y: p.y + (q.y - p.y) * t, z: p.z + (q.z - p.z) * t });
            }
          }
          const clean2 = result.filter((point, index) => !same(point, result[(index + result.length - 1) % result.length]));
          return clean2.length >= 3 && Math.abs(outlineArea(clean2)) > 1e-12 ? clean2 : [];
        };
        const removed = split(false);
        if (removed.length) outside.push(removed);
        inside = split(true);
      }
      return outside;
    });
  }
  return remaining;
}
function adaptWaterContour(source, center, along, across, yaw, negativeAlong = along, negativeAcross = across) {
  const maxX = Math.max(...source.map((p) => p.x)), minX = -Math.min(...source.map((p) => p.x)), maxZ = Math.max(...source.map((p) => p.z)), minZ = -Math.min(...source.map((p) => p.z));
  const outline = source.map((p) => {
    const x = p.x * (p.x < 0 ? negativeAlong / minX : along / maxX), z = p.z * (p.z < 0 ? negativeAcross / minZ : across / maxZ);
    return {
      x: center.x + x * Math.cos(yaw) - z * Math.sin(yaw),
      y: center.y,
      z: center.z + x * Math.sin(yaw) + z * Math.cos(yaw)
    };
  });
  return outlineArea(outline) < 0 ? outline.reverse() : outline;
}

// ../../../../private/tmp/sansu-authored-shoulder-c2/candidate/src/domain/growingIsland/authoredWaterRim.ts
function scaledWaterOutline(outline, center, scale) {
  return outline.map((p) => ({ x: center.x + (p.x - center.x) * scale, y: p.y, z: center.z + (p.z - center.z) * scale }));
}
function buildWaterRim({ id, outline, center, waterY, rings, groundAt, mouths, body, lip }) {
  const rows = rings.map((ring, row) => scaledWaterOutline(outline, center, ring.scale).map((p) => {
    const y = row === 0 ? groundAt(p) : waterY + ring.height;
    return y === void 0 ? void 0 : { ...p, y };
  }));
  if (rows.some((row) => row.some((point) => !point))) return;
  const mouthPieces = mouths.flatMap(decomposeWaterOutline);
  const result = [];
  for (let band = 0; band + 1 < rows.length; band++) {
    const vertices = [], indices = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < outline.length; i++) {
      const next = (i + 1) % outline.length;
      const quad = [rows[band][i], rows[band][next], rows[band + 1][next], rows[band + 1][i]];
      for (const triangle of [[quad[0], quad[1], quad[2]], [quad[0], quad[2], quad[3]]]) {
        for (const polygon of subtractWaterConvexPieces(triangle, mouthPieces)) {
          const offset = vertices.length;
          vertices.push(...polygon);
          for (let vertex = 1; vertex + 1 < polygon.length; vertex++) indices.push(offset, offset + vertex, offset + vertex + 1);
        }
      }
    }
    if (indices.length) result.push({
      id: `${id}:${band}`,
      kind: "bank",
      vertices,
      indices,
      material: { ...band === 1 ? lip : body, metalness: 0 }
    });
  }
  return result;
}

var EPS2 = 1e-9;
var key3 = (cell) => `${cell.x},${cell.z}`;
var refKey2 = (ref) => JSON.stringify([ref.districtId, ref.siteId]);

var area = (polygon) => polygon.reduce((sum, p, i) => {
  const q = polygon[(i + 1) % polygon.length];
  return sum + p.point.x * q.point.z - p.point.z * q.point.x;
}, 0) / 2;
var turn3 = (x, z, n) => n === 1 ? { x: -z, z: x } : n === 2 ? { x: -x, z: -z } : n === 3 ? { x: z, z: -x } : { x, z };
function localPoint(district, p) {

function intersect(polygon, outline) {
  let out = [...polygon];
  for (let i = 0; i < outline.length && out.length; i++) {
    const a = outline[i], b = outline[(i + 1) % outline.length], input = out;
    out = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < input.length; j++) {
      const p = input[j], q = input[(j + 1) % input.length], dp = cross3(a, b, p.point), dq = cross3(a, b, q.point);
      if (dp >= -EPS2) out.push(p);
      if (dp >= -EPS2 !== dq >= -EPS2 && Math.abs(dp - dq) > EPS2) {
        const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, dp / (dp - dq)));
        out.push({
          cell: { x: round(p.cell.x + (q.cell.x - p.cell.x) * t), z: round(p.cell.z + (q.cell.z - p.cell.z) * t) },
          point: { x: round(p.point.x + (q.point.x - p.point.x) * t), y: round(p.point.y + (q.point.y - p.point.y) * t), z: round(p.point.z + (q.point.z - p.point.z) * t) }
        });
      }
    }
    out = out.filter((p, j) => Math.hypot(
      p.point.x - out[(j + out.length - 1) % out.length].point.x,
      p.point.z - out[(j + out.length - 1) % out.length].point.z
    ) > 1e-8);
    if (out.length < 3 || Math.abs(area(out)) < 1e-12) return [];
  }
  return out;
}

function footBand(base2, from, to) {
  const dx = to.x - from.x, dz = to.z - from.z, length = Math.hypot(dx, dz), steps = Math.max(8, Math.ceil(length * 8)), points = [];

function rectangle(center, across, flow, minX, maxX, minZ, maxZ) {

function makeDeck(base2, district, plan, across, flow) {
  const vertices = [], indices = [], allowed = authoredWaterCarvingFloorIds(base2, district.id);
  const box = { minX: Math.min(...plan.outline.map((p) => p.x)), maxX: Math.max(...plan.outline.map((p) => p.x)), minZ: Math.min(...plan.outline.map((p) => p.z)), maxZ: Math.max(...plan.outline.map((p) => p.z)) };
  const strips = nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.deckRows.slice(1).map((row, i) => rectangle(
    plan.center,
    across,
    flow,
    nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.deckRows[i].x * plan.span / nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.span,
    row.x * plan.span / nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.span,
    -plan.width / 2,
    plan.width / 2
  ));
  for (const floor of district.floors) {
    if (floor.kind !== "ground" || allowed && !allowed.includes(JSON.stringify([district.id, floor.id]))) continue;
    for (let i = 0; i < floor.indices.length; i += 3) {
      const triangle = floor.indices.slice(i, i + 3).map((index) => ({ cell: floor.vertices[index].cell, point: worldPoint(district, floor.vertices[index].point) }));
      if (triangle.every((v) => v.point.x < box.minX) || triangle.every((v) => v.point.x > box.maxX) || triangle.every((v) => v.point.z < box.minZ) || triangle.every((v) => v.point.z > box.maxZ)) continue;
      const clipped = intersect(triangle, plan.outline);
      if (!clipped.length) continue;
      for (const strip of strips) {
        const polygon = intersect(clipped, strip);
        if (!polygon.length) continue;
        const offset = vertices.length;
        vertices.push(...polygon.map((vertex) => ({ cell: { ...vertex.cell }, point: localPoint(district, {
          ...vertex.point,
          y: authoredBridgeHeightAt(plan, (vertex.point.x - plan.center.x) * across.x + (vertex.point.z - plan.center.z) * across.z)
        }) })));
        for (let j = 1; j + 1 < polygon.length; j++) indices.push(
          offset,
          offset + (area(polygon) > 0 ? j + 1 : j),
          offset + (area(polygon) > 0 ? j : j + 1)
        );
      }
    }
  }
  return indices.length ? { id: JSON.parse(plan.deckFloorId)[1], kind: "deck", color: nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.material.color, vertices, indices } : void 0;
}
function waterClearance(world, ids, center, across, flow, span, width, archHeight) {
  let minimumDeckY = -Infinity;
  const strips = nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.deckRows.slice(1).map((row, i) => rectangle(
    center,
    across,
    flow,
    nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.deckRows[i].x * span / nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.span,
    row.x * span / nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.span,
    -width / 2,
    width / 2
  ));
  for (const floor of world.floors.filter((floor2) => floor2.kind === "water" && ids.includes(floor2.id))) for (let i = 0; i < floor.indices.length; i += 3) {
    const triangle = floor.indices.slice(i, i + 3).map((index) => floor.vertices[index]);
    for (const strip of strips) for (const vertex of intersect(triangle, strip)) {
      const localX = (vertex.point.x - center.x) * across.x + (vertex.point.z - center.z) * across.z;
      minimumDeckY = Math.max(minimumDeckY, vertex.point.y + 0.018 - authoredBridgeHeightAt({ span, archHeight, deckY: 0 }, localX));
    }
  }
  return Number.isFinite(minimumDeckY) ? minimumDeckY : void 0;
}
function dryLanding(world, outline, bedIds) {
  const box = { minX: Math.min(...outline.map((p) => p.x)), maxX: Math.max(...outline.map((p) => p.x)), minZ: Math.min(...outline.map((p) => p.z)), maxZ: Math.max(...outline.map((p) => p.z)) };
  let uncovered = [[...outline]];
  const points = [];
  for (const floor of world.floors) {
    if (floor.kind === "deck" || bedIds.has(floor.id)) continue;
    for (let i = 0; i < floor.indices.length; i += 3) {
      const triangle = floor.indices.slice(i, i + 3).map((index) => floor.vertices[index]);
      if (triangle.every((v) => v.point.x < box.minX) || triangle.every((v) => v.point.x > box.maxX) || triangle.every((v) => v.point.z < box.minZ) || triangle.every((v) => v.point.z > box.maxZ)) continue;
      const clipped = intersect(triangle, outline);
      if (!clipped.length) continue;
      if (floor.kind === "water") return;
      points.push(...clipped.map((v) => v.point));
      const stencil = clipped.map((v) => v.point);
      if (outlineArea(stencil) < 0) stencil.reverse();
      uncovered = uncovered.flatMap((piece) => subtractWaterConvexPieces(piece, [stencil]));
    }
  }
  return uncovered.reduce((sum, p) => sum + Math.abs(outlineArea(p)), 0) < 1e-9 && points.length ? points : void 0;
}
function composeAuthoredWaterBridges(state, base2, cutWorld, water) {
  let definition2 = structuredClone(cutWorld.definition), current = cutWorld;
  const bridges = [], sites = new Map(base2.sites.map((site) => [refKey2(site.ref), site]));
  const protectedOwners = protections(state, new Set(water.ownerIds));
  const bedIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...water.pools.map((pool) => pool.bedFloorId), ...water.streams.flatMap((stream) => stream.bedFloorIds)]);
  for (const owner of state.landmarks.filter((owner2) => owner2.cell && owner2.kind === "water-channel" && water.ownerIds.includes(owner2.id)).sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id))) {
    const links = water.streams.filter((stream2) => stream2.ownerIds.includes(owner.id));
    if (links.length !== 1) continue;
    const anchor = base2.anchorAt(owner.cell), site = base2.sites.find((site2) => key3(site2.cell) === key3(owner.cell)), stream = links[0];
    if (!site) continue;
    const other = Math.hypot(stream.from.x - anchor.x, stream.from.z - anchor.z) < Math.hypot(stream.to.x - anchor.x, stream.to.z - anchor.z) ? stream.to : stream.from;
    const length = Math.hypot(anchor.x - other.x, anchor.z - other.z);
    if (length < 0.05) continue;
    const flow = { x: (anchor.x - other.x) / length, z: (anchor.z - other.z) / length }, across = { x: flow.z, z: -flow.x };
    const project = (p) => ({ x: (p.x - anchor.x) * across.x + (p.z - anchor.z) * across.z, z: (p.x - anchor.x) * flow.x + (p.z - anchor.z) * flow.z });
    const candidates = [];
    for (const edge of base2.definition.edges) {
      if (!edge.allows.includes("walk") || edge.from.districtId !== site.ref.districtId || edge.to.districtId !== site.ref.districtId) continue;
      const a = sites.get(refKey2(edge.from)), b = sites.get(refKey2(edge.to));
      const mid = project({ x: (a.point.x + b.point.x) / 2, y: 0, z: (a.point.z + b.point.z) / 2 });
      if (Math.abs(mid.x) > nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.span / 2 || mid.z < -0.13 || mid.z > 0.28 || isWorldWalkEdgeSupported(current, a.cell, b.cell)) continue;
      const points2 = footBand(base2, a.cell, b.cell);
      if (!points2) continue;
      if (!bandIntersects(points2, stream.outline)) continue;
      if (points2.some((p) => {
        const q = project(p);
        return q.z < -0.16 || q.z > 0.41 || Math.abs(q.x) > nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.span / 2;
      })) continue;
      candidates.push({ edge, points: points2 });
    }
    if (!candidates.length) continue;
    const points = candidates.flatMap((candidate) => candidate.points).map(project), minX = Math.min(...points.map((p) => p.x)) - 0.01, maxX = Math.max(...points.map((p) => p.x)) + 0.01, minZ = Math.min(...points.map((p) => p.z)) - 0.01, maxZ = Math.max(...points.map((p) => p.z)) + 0.01;
    const span = Math.max(nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.span * 0.4, maxX - minX), width = Math.max(nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.width, maxZ - minZ);
    if (span > nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.span + EPS2 || width > nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.width * 1.4) continue;
    const cx = (minX + maxX) / 2, cz = (minZ + maxZ) / 2, center = { x: anchor.x + across.x * cx + flow.x * cz, y: 0, z: anchor.z + across.z * cx + flow.z * cz };
    const outline = rectangle(center, across, flow, -span / 2, span / 2, -width / 2, width / 2), footprint = rectangle(
      center,
      across,
      flow,
      nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.bounds.min[0] * span / nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.span,
      nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.bounds.max[0] * span / nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.span,
      nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.bounds.min[2] * width / nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.width,
      nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.bounds.max[2] * width / nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.width
    );
    if (!isAuthoredWaterCarvingSafe(base2, site.ref.districtId, footprint, protectedOwners) || water.pools.some((pool) => overlaps(outline, pool.outline)) || water.grottos.some((grotto) => overlaps(footprint, grotto.footprint))) continue;
    const landings = [-1, 1].map((side) => dryLanding(current, rectangle(
      center,
      across,
      flow,
      side * span / 2 - 0.015,
      side * span / 2 + 0.015,
      -width / 2,
      width / 2
    ), bedIds));
    if (landings.some((landing) => !landing)) continue;
    const landingPoints = landings.flatMap((landing) => landing);
    if (Math.max(...landingPoints.map((p) => p.y)) - Math.min(...landingPoints.map((p) => p.y)) > 0.12) continue;
    const archHeight = nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.archHeight * span / nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.span;
    const clearDeckY = waterClearance(current, stream.waterFloorIds, center, across, flow, span, width, archHeight);
    if (clearDeckY === void 0) continue;
    const deckY = Math.max(Math.max(...landingPoints.map((p) => p.y)) + 6e-3, clearDeckY);
    if (deckY - Math.min(...landingPoints.map((p) => p.y)) > 0.12) continue;
    const localId2 = `authored-water:bridge:${encodeURIComponent(owner.id)}`;
    const plan = {
      ownerId: owner.id,
      districtId: site.ref.districtId,
      deckFloorId: JSON.stringify([site.ref.districtId, localId2]),
      sourceId: nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.source.id,
      sourceSHA: nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default.source.sha256,
      center: { ...center, y: round(deckY) },
      yaw: Math.atan2(flow.x, flow.z),
      span: round(span),
      width: round(width),
      deckY: round(deckY),
      archHeight: round(archHeight),
      outline,
      footprint,
      landingPoints,
      restoredEdgeIds: []
    };
    const district = base2.definition.districts.find((district2) => district2.id === site.ref.districtId), deck = makeDeck(base2, district, plan, across, flow);
    if (!deck) continue;
    const next = { ...definition2, districts: definition2.districts.map((district2) => district2.id === site.ref.districtId ? { ...district2, floors: [...district2.floors, deck] } : district2) };
    const supported = compileWorldDefinition(next);
    if (candidates.some(({ edge }) => !isWorldWalkEdgeSupported(supported, sites.get(refKey2(edge.from)).cell, sites.get(refKey2(edge.to)).cell))) continue;
    plan.restoredEdgeIds = candidates.map(({ edge }) => edgeKey(edge));
    definition2 = next;
    current = supported;
    bridges.push(plan);
  }
  return { definition: definition2, bridges };
}
