var EPS3 = 1e-9;
var SURFACE_RISE = 0.025;
var DEPTH = 0.18;
var WATER_COLORS = ["#287ca6", "#287ca6", "#287ca6"];
var BED_COLORS = ["#667e96", "#727e9c", "#647f8d"];
var key4 = (cell) => `${cell.x},${cell.z}`;
var waterNeighbors2 = (base2, cell) => base2.neighbors(cell, "water").filter((next) => Number.isInteger(cell.x) && Number.isInteger(cell.z) && Number.isInteger(next.x) && Number.isInteger(next.z) && Math.abs(cell.x - next.x) + Math.abs(cell.z - next.z) === 1);
var round2 = (value) => Math.round(value * 1e9) / 1e9 || 0;
var horizontal = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.z - b.z);
var cross4 = (a, b, p) => (b.x - a.x) * (p.z - a.z) - (b.z - a.z) * (p.x - a.x);
var area2 = (polygon) => polygon.reduce((sum, vertex, i) => {
  const next = polygon[(i + 1) % polygon.length];
  return sum + vertex.point.x * next.point.z - vertex.point.z * next.point.x;
}, 0) / 2;
var turn4 = (x, z, count) => count === 1 ? { x: -z, z: x } : count === 2 ? { x: -x, z: -z } : count === 3 ? { x: z, z: -x } : { x, z };
var pointToLocal = (district, point) => {
  const p = turn4(point.x - district.worldOrigin.x, point.z - district.worldOrigin.z, (4 - district.turn) % 4);
  return { x: round2(p.x), y: round2(point.y - district.worldOrigin.y), z: round2(p.z) };
};
var pointToWorld = (district, point) => {
  const p = turn4(point.x, point.z, district.turn);
  return { x: p.x + district.worldOrigin.x, y: point.y + district.worldOrigin.y, z: p.z + district.worldOrigin.z };
};
var cellToWorld = (district, cell) => {
  const p = turn4(cell.x, cell.z, district.turn);
  return { x: p.x + district.logicalOrigin.x, z: p.z + district.logicalOrigin.z };
};
var floorId = (districtId, local) => JSON.stringify([districtId, local]);
var localId = (kind, id) => `authored-water:${kind}:${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
var refKey3 = (ref) => JSON.stringify([ref.districtId, ref.siteId]);
function freeze2(value) {
  if (value && typeof value === "object" && !Object.isFrozen(value)) {
    Object.values(value).forEach(freeze2);
    Object.freeze(value);
  }
  return value;
}
function fingerprint(text) {
  let a = 2166136261, b = 2246822507;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    a = Math.imul(a ^ text.charCodeAt(i), 16777619);
    b = Math.imul(b ^ text.charCodeAt(i), 3266489909);
  }
  return `${(a >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}${(b >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`;
}
function clean(polygon) {
  const out = polygon.filter((vertex, i) => horizontal(vertex.point, polygon[(i + polygon.length - 1) % polygon.length].point) > 1e-8);
  return out.length >= 3 && Math.abs(area2(out)) > 1e-10 ? out : [];
}
function interpolate2(a, b, t) {
  return {
    cell: { x: round2(a.cell.x + (b.cell.x - a.cell.x) * t), z: round2(a.cell.z + (b.cell.z - a.cell.z) * t) },
    point: {
      x: round2(a.point.x + (b.point.x - a.point.x) * t),
      y: round2(a.point.y + (b.point.y - a.point.y) * t),
      z: round2(a.point.z + (b.point.z - a.point.z) * t)
    },
    // Keep the linear source field through repeated cuts. Normalizing each
    // intermediate split would change later barycentric interpolation.
    ...a.normal && b.normal ? { normal: {
      x: a.normal.x + (b.normal.x - a.normal.x) * t,
      y: a.normal.y + (b.normal.y - a.normal.y) * t,
      z: a.normal.z + (b.normal.z - a.normal.z) * t
    } } : {}
  };
}
function halfPlane(polygon, a, b, inside) {
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < polygon.length; i++) {
    const p = polygon[i], q = polygon[(i + 1) % polygon.length];
    const dp = cross4(a, b, p.point), dq = cross4(a, b, q.point);
    const keepP = inside ? dp >= -EPS3 : dp <= EPS3, keepQ = inside ? dq >= -EPS3 : dq <= EPS3;
    if (keepP) out.push(p);
    if (keepP !== keepQ && Math.abs(dp - dq) > EPS3) out.push(interpolate2(p, q, Math.max(0, Math.min(1, dp / (dp - dq)))));
  }
  return clean(out);
}
function subtract(polygon, outline) {
  const outside = [];
  let inside = [...polygon];
  for (let i = 0; i < outline.length && inside.length; i++) {
    const a = outline[i], b = outline[(i + 1) % outline.length];
    const piece = halfPlane(inside, a, b, false);
    if (piece.length) outside.push(piece);
    inside = halfPlane(inside, a, b, true);
  }
  return { outside, inside };
}
function append(floor, polygon, up = false) {
  if (!polygon.length) return;
  const offset = floor.vertices.length;
  floor.vertices.push(...polygon);
  const reverse = up && area2(polygon) > 0;
  for (let i = 1; i + 1 < polygon.length; i++) {
    const a = polygon[0].cell, b = polygon[i].cell, c = polygon[i + 1].cell;
    if (Math.abs((b.x - a.x) * (c.z - a.z) - (b.z - a.z) * (c.x - a.x)) <= 1e-12) continue;
    floor.indices.push(offset, offset + (reverse ? i + 1 : i), offset + (reverse ? i : i + 1));
  }
}
function protectedCells(state, excluded) {
  const half2 = AUTHORED_OWNER_HALF_EXTENT + AUTHORED_WALK_HALF_WIDTH;
  const out = HOUSE_CELLS.map((cell) => ({ cell, half: half2 }));
  for (const item of [...state.plots, ...state.landmarks, ...state.keepsakes]) {
    if (!item.cell || excluded.has(item.id)) continue;
    out.push({ cell: item.cell, half: half2 });
    if ("kind" in item && item.kind === "home") out.push({ cell: { x: item.cell.x, z: item.cell.z + 0.75 }, half: 0.18 });
  }
  return out;
}
function safeOutline(base2, outline, protections2, districtId) {
  const candidates = districtId ? [districtId] : base2.definition.districts.map((district) => district.id);
  return candidates.some((id) => isAuthoredWaterCarvingSafe(base2, id, outline, protections2));
}
function poolFor(owner, index, bowls, base2, protections2) {
  const site = base2.sites.find((site2) => key4(site2.cell) === key4(owner.cell));
  const center = base2.anchorAt(owner.cell) ?? base2.floorAt(owner.cell)?.point;
  if (!site?.placement || !center) return;
  const source = nativeWaterSource_default.pools[index % nativeWaterSource_default.pools.length];
  const neighbors = bowls.filter((bowl) => bowl.id !== owner.id).map((bowl) => base2.anchorAt(bowl.cell)).filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => horizontal(center, a) - horizontal(center, b));
  const nearest = neighbors[0], yaw = nearest ? Math.atan2(nearest.z - center.z, nearest.x - center.x) : 0;
  const requested = [source.radiusX, source.radiusZ, source.radiusX, source.radiusZ];
  const axes = requested.map((value) => Math.min(value, 0.24));
  const outerScale = nativeWaterSource_default.rim.rings[0].scale;
  const shape = () => adaptWaterContour(source.outline, center, axes[0], axes[1], yaw, axes[2], axes[3]);
  const valid = (outline2) => {
    const outer = scaledWaterOutline(outline2, center, outerScale);
    if (outer.some((p) => neighbors.some((other) => {
      const d = horizontal(center, other), projection = ((p.x - center.x) * (other.x - center.x) + (p.z - center.z) * (other.z - center.z)) / d;
      return projection > d / 2 - 0.025;
    }))) return false;
    return safeOutline(base2, outer, protections2, site.ref.districtId);
  };
  if (!valid(shape()) || !decomposeWaterOutline(shape()).length) return;
  for (const axis of [1, 3, 0, 2]) {
    while (axes[axis] + 0.02 <= requested[axis] + EPS3) {
      axes[axis] += 0.02;
      if (!valid(shape())) {
        axes[axis] -= 0.02;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  const outline = shape(), waterY = round2(center.y + SURFACE_RISE), bedY = round2(waterY - DEPTH);
  return {
    ownerId: owner.id,
    ownerIds: [owner.id],
    districtId: site.ref.districtId,
    center: { ...center },
    radius: round2(Math.max(...axes)),
    axes: axes.map(round2),
    sourceRole: source.role,
    waterY,
    bedY,
    outline,
    outerOutline: scaledWaterOutline(outline, center, outerScale),
    waterFloorId: floorId(site.ref.districtId, localId("pool-water", owner.id)),
    bedFloorId: floorId(site.ref.districtId, localId("pool-bed", owner.id)),
    color: WATER_COLORS[index % 3],
    bedColor: BED_COLORS[index % 3]
  };
}
function poolMouthDistance(pool, dx, dz, width) {
  if (!pool) return 0;
  let distance3 = Infinity;
  for (const side of [-width, width]) {
    const origin = { x: pool.center.x + dz * side, y: pool.center.y, z: pool.center.z - dx * side };
    const exit = waterRayExit(origin, dx, dz, pool.outline);
    if (exit === void 0) return;
    distance3 = Math.min(distance3, exit);
  }
  return Number.isFinite(distance3) && distance3 > 0.025 ? distance3 - 0.025 : void 0;
}
function intersectionPoints(a, b) {
  return [
    ...a.filter((p) => pointInWaterOutline(p, b)),
    ...b.filter((p) => pointInWaterOutline(p, a)),
    ...a.flatMap((p, i) => waterSegmentIntervals(p, a[(i + 1) % a.length], b).flatMap((interval) => interval.map((t) => ({
      x: p.x + (a[(i + 1) % a.length].x - p.x) * t,
      y: p.y,
      z: p.z + (a[(i + 1) % a.length].z - p.z) * t
    }))))
  ];
}
function streamFor(a, b, pools, base2, protections2, adjoining = []) {
  const a0 = base2.anchorAt(a.cell), b0 = base2.anchorAt(b.cell);
  if (!a0 || !b0) return;
  const length = horizontal(a0, b0);
  if (length <= 0.05) return;
  const dx = (b0.x - a0.x) / length, dz = (b0.z - a0.z) / length;
  const aPool = pools.find((pool) => pool.ownerId === a.id), bPool = pools.find((pool) => pool.ownerId === b.id);
  const width = 0.135, fromTrim = poolMouthDistance(aPool, dx, dz, width), toTrim = poolMouthDistance(bPool, -dx, -dz, width);
  if (fromTrim === void 0 || toTrim === void 0) return;
  const from = { x: a0.x + dx * fromTrim, y: a0.y + SURFACE_RISE, z: a0.z + dz * fromTrim };
  const to = { x: b0.x - dx * toTrim, y: b0.y + SURFACE_RISE, z: b0.z - dz * toTrim };
  if (horizontal(from, to) <= 0.05) return;
  const seed = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => {
    const t = i / 8, bend = 0.035 * Math.sin(Math.PI * t);
    return {
      x: from.x + (to.x - from.x) * t + dz * bend,
      y: from.y,
      z: from.z + (to.z - from.z) * t - dx * bend
    };
  });
  const seedOutline = [
    ...seed.map((p) => ({ ...p, x: p.x + dz * width, z: p.z - dx * width })),
    ...[...seed].reverse().map((p) => ({ ...p, x: p.x - dz * width, z: p.z + dx * width }))
  ];
  const vx = to.x - from.x, vz = to.z - from.z, squared = vx * vx + vz * vz;
  const projection = (p) => ((p.x - from.x) * vx + (p.z - from.z) * vz) / squared;
  const id = JSON.stringify([a.id, b.id].sort());
  const junctionPoints = (ownerId) => adjoining.filter((other) => other.id !== id && other.ownerIds.includes(ownerId)).flatMap((other) => intersectionPoints(seedOutline, other.outline));
  const startPoints = [...aPool?.outline ?? [], ...junctionPoints(a.id)], endPoints = [...bPool?.outline ?? [], ...junctionPoints(b.id)];
  const dropStart = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Math.max(0, ...startPoints.map(projection))));
  const dropEnd = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Math.min(1, ...endPoints.map(projection))));
  if (dropEnd - dropStart < 1e-6 && Math.abs(from.y - to.y) > EPS3) return;
  const knots = [...new Set([...seed.map((_, i) => i / 8), dropStart, dropEnd].map(round2))].sort((a2, b2) => a2 - b2);
  const centerline = knots.map((t) => {
    const i = Math.min(7, Math.floor(t * 8)), u = t * 8 - i;
    const fall = dropEnd - dropStart > EPS3 ? smoothFall(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - dropStart) / (dropEnd - dropStart)))) : 0;
    return {
      x: seed[i].x + (seed[i + 1].x - seed[i].x) * u,
      y: from.y + (to.y - from.y) * fall,
      z: seed[i].z + (seed[i + 1].z - seed[i].z) * u
    };
  });
  const left = centerline.map((p) => ({ ...p, x: p.x + dz * width, z: p.z - dx * width }));
  const right = centerline.map((p) => ({ ...p, x: p.x - dz * width, z: p.z + dx * width }));
  const outline = [...left, ...[...right].reverse()];
  const ownerDistricts = new Set([a, b].map((owner) => base2.sites.find((site) => key4(site.cell) === key4(owner.cell))?.ref.districtId));
  if (ownerDistricts.size !== 1 || ownerDistricts.has(void 0)) return;
  const districtIds = base2.definition.districts.filter((district) => ownerDistricts.has(district.id) && isAuthoredWaterCarvingSafe(base2, district.id, outline, protections2)).map((district) => district.id);
  if (!districtIds.length) return;
  const stream = {
    id,
    ownerIds: [a.id, b.id],
    from,
    to,
    outline,
    centerline,
    width: width * 2,
    waterFloorIds: [],
    bedFloorIds: [],
    falling: Math.abs(from.y - to.y) > 0.06
  };
  const common = { districtIds, ownerIds: [...stream.ownerIds], color: "#50b5ca", bedColor: "#667e96", stream };
  return centerline.slice(1).map((end, i) => ({
    ...common,
    id: `stream:${id}:${i}`,
    outline: [left[i], left[i + 1], right[i + 1], right[i]],
    heightAt: (point) => {
      const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (projection(point) - knots[i]) / (knots[i + 1] - knots[i])));
      return round2(centerline[i].y + (end.y - centerline[i].y) * t);
    }
  }));
}
var smoothFall = (t) => t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
function bounds(outline) {
  return {
    minX: Math.min(...outline.map((p) => p.x)),
    maxX: Math.max(...outline.map((p) => p.x)),
    minZ: Math.min(...outline.map((p) => p.z)),
    maxZ: Math.max(...outline.map((p) => p.z))
  };
}
var overlaps2 = (a, b) => a.minX <= b.maxX + EPS3 && a.maxX + EPS3 >= b.minX && a.minZ <= b.maxZ + EPS3 && a.maxZ + EPS3 >= b.minZ;
function floorIntersectsOutline(floor, district, outline) {
  const box = bounds(outline), pieces = decomposeWaterOutline(outline), vertices = floor.vertices.map((vertex) => ({ ...vertex, point: pointToWorld(district, vertex.point) }));
  for (let i = 0; i < floor.indices.length; i += 3) {
    const triangle = floor.indices.slice(i, i + 3).map((index) => vertices[index]);
    if (overlaps2(bounds(triangle.map((vertex) => vertex.point)), box) && pieces.some((piece) => subtract(triangle, piece).inside.length)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
function bankIntervals(a, b, outlines) {
  let intervals = [[0, 1]];
  for (const outline of outlines) for (const [min, max] of waterSegmentIntervals(a, b, outline)) {
    intervals = intervals.flatMap(([lo, hi]) => max <= lo || min >= hi ? [[lo, hi]] : [...lo < min ? [[lo, min]] : [], ...max < hi ? [[max, hi]] : []]);
  }
  return intervals;
}
function bankFor(cut, district, base2, others) {
  if (cut.pool) {
    const surfaces = buildWaterRim({
      id: localId("bank", cut.id),
      outline: cut.pool.outline,
      center: cut.pool.center,
      waterY: cut.pool.waterY,
      rings: nativeWaterSource_default.rim.rings,
      groundAt: (p) => {
        const cell = base2.logicalAt(p);
        return cell ? base2.floorAt(cell)?.point.y : void 0;
      },
      mouths: others.filter((other) => other !== cut).map((other) => other.outline),
      body: nativeWaterSource_default.rim.body,
      lip: nativeWaterSource_default.rim.lip
    });
    return (surfaces ?? []).map((surface) => ({ ...surface, vertices: surface.vertices.map((p) => pointToLocal(district, p)) }));
  }
  const vertices = [], indices = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < cut.outline.length; i++) {
    const a0 = cut.outline[i], b0 = cut.outline[(i + 1) % cut.outline.length];
    const top = (p) => {
      const cell = base2.logicalAt(p), y = cell ? base2.floorAt(cell)?.point.y : void 0;
      return pointToLocal(district, { ...p, y: Math.max(y ?? cut.heightAt(p), cut.heightAt(p) + 0.035) });
    };
    for (const [from, to] of bankIntervals(a0, b0, others.filter((other) => other !== cut).map((other) => other.outline))) {
      const at = (t) => ({ x: a0.x + (b0.x - a0.x) * t, y: a0.y + (b0.y - a0.y) * t, z: a0.z + (b0.z - a0.z) * t });
      const a = at(from), b = at(to), offset = vertices.length;
      if (horizontal(a, b) <= 1e-9) continue;
      vertices.push(top(a), top(b), pointToLocal(district, { ...b, y: cut.heightAt(b) - DEPTH }), pointToLocal(district, { ...a, y: cut.heightAt(a) - DEPTH }));
      indices.push(offset, offset + 1, offset + 2, offset, offset + 2, offset + 3);
    }
  }
  if (!indices.length) return [];
  return [{ id: localId("bank", cut.id), kind: "bank", vertices, indices, material: { color: nativeWaterSource_default.rim.body.color, roughness: 0.56, metalness: 0 } }];
}
function flowFor(cut, district) {
  if (!cut.stream?.falling) return;
  const stream = cut.stream, length = horizontal(stream.from, stream.to), dx = (stream.to.x - stream.from.x) / length, dz = (stream.to.z - stream.from.z) / length, width = stream.width / 2;
  const vertices = stream.centerline.flatMap((p) => [
    { x: p.x + dz * width, y: p.y + 2e-3, z: p.z - dx * width },
    { x: p.x - dz * width, y: p.y + 2e-3, z: p.z + dx * width }
  ].map((p2) => pointToLocal(district, p2)));
  const indices = stream.centerline.slice(1).flatMap((_, i) => [i * 2, i * 2 + 2, i * 2 + 3, i * 2, i * 2 + 3, i * 2 + 1]);
  return {
    id: localId("flow", stream.id),
    kind: "flow",
    vertices,
    indices,
    material: { color: "#50b5ca", roughness: 0.16, metalness: 0, opacity: 0.82 }
  };
}
function grottoFor(pool, streams, base2, protections2) {
  const link = streams.find((stream) => stream.ownerIds.includes(pool.ownerId));
  if (!link) return;
  const target = horizontal(link.from, pool.center) < horizontal(link.to, pool.center) ? link.to : link.from;
  const length = horizontal(target, pool.center), dx = (target.x - pool.center.x) / length, dz = (target.z - pool.center.z) / length;
  const yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, dz), sourceVertices = nativeWaterSource_default.grotto.primitives.flatMap((part) => part.vertices);
  for (const scale of [1, 0.95, 0.9, 0.85, 0.8, 0.75, 0.7, 0.65, 0.6]) {
    const pivot = { x: pool.center.x - dx * 0.07, y: pool.bedY - 0.025, z: pool.center.z - dz * 0.07 };
    const transform = (p) => ({
      x: pivot.x + scale * (p.x * Math.cos(yaw) - p.z * Math.sin(yaw)),
      y: pivot.y + p.y * scale,
      z: pivot.z + scale * (p.x * Math.sin(yaw) + p.z * Math.cos(yaw))
    });
    const vertices = sourceVertices.map(transform), box = bounds(vertices);
    const footprint = [
      { x: box.minX, y: pivot.y, z: box.minZ },
      { x: box.maxX, y: pivot.y, z: box.minZ },
      { x: box.maxX, y: pivot.y, z: box.maxZ },
      { x: box.minX, y: pivot.y, z: box.maxZ }
    ];
    if (!safeOutline(base2, footprint, protections2, pool.districtId) || sourceVertices.filter((p) => p.y < 0.035).some((p) => !pointInWaterOutline(transform(p), pool.outline))) continue;
    const surfaces = nativeWaterSource_default.grotto.primitives.map((part, i) => ({
      id: localId("grotto", `${pool.ownerId}:${i}`),
      kind: "bank",
      vertices: part.vertices.map(transform),
      indices: part.indices,
      material: part.material
    }));
    return { plan: {
      ownerId: pool.ownerId,
      pivot,
      yaw,
      scale,
      footprint,
      surfaceIds: surfaces.map((surface) => floorId(pool.districtId, surface.id))
    }, surfaces };
  }
}
function composeAuthoredWaterWorld(state, base2) {
  const supplied = connectedWaterChannels(waterLayout(state, base2));
  const owners = state.landmarks.filter((owner) => !!owner.cell && base2.owns(owner.cell) && (owner.kind === "water-bowl" || owner.kind === "water-channel" && supplied.has(key4(owner.cell)))).sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
  const byCell = new Map(owners.map((owner) => [key4(owner.cell), owner]));
  const groups = [], pools = [], cuts = [], streams = [];
  const seen = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const owner of owners) {
    if (seen.has(owner.id)) continue;
    const members = [owner];
    seen.add(owner.id);
    for (let i = 0; i < members.length; i++) for (const cell of waterNeighbors2(base2, members[i].cell)) {
      const other = byCell.get(key4(cell));
      if (!other || seen.has(other.id)) continue;
      seen.add(other.id);
      members.push(other);
    }
    members.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
    const bowls = members.filter((member) => member.kind === "water-bowl").sort((a, b) => (base2.anchorAt(b.cell)?.y ?? 0) - (base2.anchorAt(a.cell)?.y ?? 0) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id)), channels = members.filter((member) => member.kind === "water-channel");
    const group = {
      id: `water-group:${JSON.stringify(members.map((member) => member.id))}`,
      ownerIds: members.map((member) => member.id),
      bowlIds: bowls.map((bowl) => bowl.id),
      channelIds: channels.map((channel) => channel.id),
      cut: false,
      reason: "individual-bodies"
    };
    groups.push(group);
    if (bowls.length < 3 || channels.length < 2) continue;
    const protections2 = protectedCells(state, new Set(group.ownerIds));
    const nextPools = bowls.map((bowl, i) => poolFor(bowl, i, bowls, base2, protections2));
    if (nextPools.some((pool) => !pool)) {
      group.reason = "insufficient-clearance";
      continue;
    }
    const edgeIds = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), links = [];
    for (const member of members) for (const cell of waterNeighbors2(base2, member.cell)) {
      const other = byCell.get(key4(cell));
      if (!other || !group.ownerIds.includes(other.id)) continue;
      const id = JSON.stringify([member.id, other.id].sort());
      if (edgeIds.has(id)) continue;
      edgeIds.add(id);
      links.push([member, other]);
    }
    const initialStreams = links.map(([a, b]) => streamFor(a, b, nextPools, base2, protections2));
    const adjoining = initialStreams.filter((cut) => !!cut).map((cut) => cut[0].stream);
    const nextStreams = initialStreams.some((stream) => !stream) ? initialStreams : links.map(([a, b]) => streamFor(a, b, nextPools, base2, protections2, adjoining));
    if (nextStreams.some((stream) => !stream)) {
      group.reason = "insufficient-clearance";
      continue;
    }
    group.cut = true;
    delete group.reason;
    for (const pool of nextPools) {
      pools.push(pool);
      cuts.push({
        id: `pool:${pool.ownerId}`,
        outline: pool.outline,
        outerOutline: pool.outerOutline,
        districtIds: [pool.districtId],
        color: pool.color,
        bedColor: pool.bedColor,
        ownerIds: [pool.ownerId],
        heightAt: () => pool.waterY,
        pool
      });
    }
    for (const nextCuts of nextStreams) {
      cuts.push(...nextCuts);
      streams.push(nextCuts[0].stream);
    }
  }
  const grottoCandidates = groups.filter((group) => group.cut).flatMap((group) => {
    const upper = pools.find((pool) => group.bowlIds.includes(pool.ownerId));
    const result = upper && grottoFor(upper, streams, base2, protectedCells(state, new Set(group.ownerIds)));
    return result ? [{ districtId: upper.districtId, ...result }] : [];
  });
  const revision = `authored-water-v2:${fingerprint(JSON.stringify({
    base: [base2.id, base2.definition.revision, base2.definition.source],
    profile: nativeWaterSource_default,
    scopes: base2.definition.districts.map((district) => [district.id, district.waterCarvingScopes]),
    water: owners.map((owner) => [owner.id, owner.kind, owner.cell, owner.growth]),
    obstacles: protectedCells(state, /* @__PURE__ */ new Set()).map((p) => [p.cell, p.half]),
    pools: pools.map((pool) => [pool.ownerId, pool.axes, pool.outline, pool.outerOutline]),
    streams: streams.map((stream) => [stream.id, stream.outline, stream.centerline]),
    grottos: grottoCandidates.map((grotto) => grotto.plan)
  }))}`;
  const plan = { revision, ownerIds: [...new Set(cuts.flatMap((cut) => cut.ownerIds))], groups, pools, streams, grottos: grottoCandidates.map((grotto) => grotto.plan), bridges: [] };
  const actualCuts = [];
  let definition2 = structuredClone(base2.definition);
  definition2.revision = revision;
  definition2.districts = definition2.districts.map((district) => {
    const worldCuts = cuts.filter((cut) => cut.districtIds.includes(district.id));
    const localCuts = worldCuts.map((cut) => {
      const outline = cut.outline.map((p) => pointToLocal(district, p)), outerOutline = (cut.outerOutline ?? cut.outline).map((p) => pointToLocal(district, p));
      return { cut, pieces: decomposeWaterOutline(outline), outerPieces: decomposeWaterOutline(outerOutline), box: bounds(outerOutline) };
    });
    const additions = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    const floors = district.floors.flatMap((floor) => {
      const allowedFloors = authoredWaterCarvingFloorIds(base2, district.id);
      if (floor.kind !== "ground" || !localCuts.length || allowedFloors && !allowedFloors.includes(floorId(district.id, floor.id))) return [floor];
      const vertices = [...floor.vertices], indices = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < floor.indices.length; i += 3) {
        const sourceIndices = floor.indices.slice(i, i + 3), triangle = sourceIndices.map((index) => floor.vertices[index]);
        const box = bounds(triangle.map((v) => v.point)), applicable = localCuts.filter((cut) => overlaps2(box, cut.box));
        if (!applicable.length) {
          indices.push(...sourceIndices);
          continue;
        }
        let remaining = [triangle], changed = false;
        for (const { outerPieces } of applicable) for (const outline of outerPieces) {
          const next = [];
          for (const polygon of remaining) {
            const pieces = subtract(polygon, outline);
            changed ||= !!pieces.inside.length;
            next.push(...pieces.inside.length ? pieces.outside : [polygon]);
          }
          remaining = next;
        }
        if (!changed) indices.push(...sourceIndices);
        else for (const polygon of remaining) append({ vertices, indices }, polygon);
        let wetRemaining = [triangle];
        for (const { cut, pieces: wetPieces } of applicable) for (const outline of wetPieces) {
          const next = [];
          for (const polygon of wetRemaining) {
            const pieces = subtract(polygon, outline);
            if (!pieces.inside.length) {
              next.push(polygon);
              continue;
            }
            next.push(...pieces.outside);
            let addition = additions.get(cut);
            if (!addition) {
              const waterLocalId = cut.pool ? localId("pool-water", cut.pool.ownerId) : localId("stream-water", cut.id);
              const bedLocalId = cut.pool ? localId("pool-bed", cut.pool.ownerId) : localId("stream-bed", cut.id);
              addition = {
                water: { id: waterLocalId, kind: "water", color: cut.color, vertices: [], indices: [] },
                bed: { id: bedLocalId, kind: "ground", color: cut.bedColor, vertices: [], indices: [] }
              };
              additions.set(cut, addition);
            }
            const wet = pieces.inside.map((vertex) => ({ cell: { ...vertex.cell }, point: {
              ...vertex.point,
              y: round2(cut.heightAt(pointToWorld(district, vertex.point)) - district.worldOrigin.y)
            } }));
            append(addition.water, wet, true);
            append(addition.bed, wet.map((vertex) => ({ cell: { ...vertex.cell }, point: { ...vertex.point, y: round2(vertex.point.y - DEPTH) } })), true);
          }
          wetRemaining = next;
        }
      }
      return indices.length ? [{ ...floor, vertices, indices }] : [];
    });
    const surfaces = [...district.surfaces ?? [], ...grottoCandidates.filter((grotto) => grotto.districtId === district.id).flatMap((grotto) => grotto.surfaces.map((surface) => ({ ...surface, vertices: surface.vertices.map((p) => pointToLocal(district, p)) })))];
    for (const [cut, addition] of additions) {
      if (!addition.water.indices.length || !addition.bed.indices.length) continue;
      floors.push(addition.water, addition.bed);
      actualCuts.push({ cut, district, ...addition });
      if (cut.stream) {
        cut.stream.waterFloorIds.push(floorId(district.id, addition.water.id));
        cut.stream.bedFloorIds.push(floorId(district.id, addition.bed.id));
      }
      surfaces.push(...bankFor(cut, district, base2, worldCuts));
      const flow = flowFor(cut, district);
      if (flow && !surfaces.some((surface) => surface.id === flow.id)) surfaces.push(flow);
    }
    return {
      ...district,
      floors,
      surfaces,
      anchorFloors: district.anchorFloors ?? district.floors,
      sites: district.sites.map((site) => ({ ...site, anchorPoint: pointToLocal(district, base2.anchorAt(cellToWorld(district, site.cell))) }))
    };
  });
  for (const stream of streams) {
    const group = groups.find((group2) => group2.cut && stream.ownerIds.every((id) => group2.ownerIds.includes(id)));
    const waterIds = new Set(stream.waterFloorIds), bedIds = new Set(stream.bedFloorIds);
    for (const actual of actualCuts) {
      if (!actual.cut.ownerIds.every((id) => group.ownerIds.includes(id)) || !floorIntersectsOutline(actual.water, actual.district, stream.outline)) continue;
      waterIds.add(floorId(actual.district.id, actual.water.id));
      bedIds.add(floorId(actual.district.id, actual.bed.id));
    }
    stream.waterFloorIds = [...waterIds];
    stream.bedFloorIds = [...bedIds];
  }
  const sourceEdges = definition2.edges;
  definition2.edges = sourceEdges.map((edge) => ({ ...edge, allows: edge.allows.filter((kind) => kind !== "walk") })).filter((edge) => edge.allows.length);
  const cutWorld = compileWorldDefinition(definition2), bridgeComposition = composeAuthoredWaterBridges(state, base2, cutWorld, plan);
  definition2 = bridgeComposition.definition;
  plan.bridges = bridgeComposition.bridges;
  const supportWorld = plan.bridges.length ? compileWorldDefinition(definition2) : cutWorld, refs = new Map(supportWorld.sites.map((site) => [refKey3(site.ref), site.cell]));
  definition2.edges = sourceEdges.map((edge) => ({ ...edge, allows: edge.allows.filter((kind) => kind !== "walk" || isWorldWalkEdgeSupported(supportWorld, refs.get(refKey3(edge.from)), refs.get(refKey3(edge.to)))) })).filter((edge) => edge.allows.length);
  const dryWorld = compileWorldDefinition(definition2);
  definition2.districts = definition2.districts.map((district) => ({ ...district, shoreAccess: owners.filter((owner) => plan.ownerIds.includes(owner.id)).map((owner) => {
    const site = dryWorld.sites.find((site2) => site2.ref.districtId === district.id && key4(site2.cell) === key4(owner.cell));
    if (!site) return void 0;
    const waterFloorIds = [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([
      ...pools.filter((pool) => pool.ownerIds.includes(owner.id)).map((pool) => pool.waterFloorId),
      ...streams.filter((stream) => stream.ownerIds.includes(owner.id)).flatMap((stream) => stream.waterFloorIds)
    ])];
    return { ownerSiteId: site.ref.siteId, waterFloorIds: waterFloorIds.filter((id) => JSON.parse(id)[0] === district.id).map((id) => JSON.parse(id)[1]), entrySiteIds: findAuthoredShoreEntries(dryWorld, waterFloorIds).filter((ref) => ref.districtId === district.id).map((ref) => ref.siteId) };
  }).filter((access) => !!access) }));
  const finalRevision = `${revision}:${fingerprint(JSON.stringify({ bridgeProfile: nativeWaterBridgeProfile_default, bridges: plan.bridges, shore: definition2.districts.map((district) => [district.id, district.shoreAccess]) }))}`;
  definition2.revision = finalRevision;
  plan.revision = finalRevision;
  return { world: compileWorldDefinition(definition2), plan: freeze2(plan) };
}

// ../../../../private/tmp/sansu-authored-shoulder-c2/candidate/src/domain/growingIsland/authoredShoulderWorld.ts
var AUTHORED_SHOULDER_CANDIDATE = "native05-central-shoulder-sw-v3-source-v1";
var AUTHORED_SHOULDER_COMPONENT_SHA = "c79e2cd7a228b24ff526e6d78913f6a07880e35dec1532d4c278dd7cbf10411e";
var BASE_SHA = "8398eda9ac084a6e80ed22f1a82670c380b017544a177106325aaa7ba7f8f68d";
var GEOMETRY_SHA = "7b4772489932b225d7b31ced5bd53c6835a47e8e63c71eeb43d7b59af1523d3b";
var DISTRICT = "diagnostic-central-shoulder-c-feasibility";
var fail = (message) => {
  throw new Error(`Authored shoulder: ${message}`);
};
var refKey4 = (ref) => JSON.stringify([ref.districtId, ref.siteId]);
var physicalVertex = ({ cell, point }) => ({ cell, point });
var physicalFloor = (floor) => ({ id: floor.id, kind: floor.kind, vertices: floor.vertices.map(physicalVertex), indices: floor.indices });
function fingerprint2(value) {
  const text = JSON.stringify(value);
  let a = 2166136261, b = 2246822507;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    a = Math.imul(a ^ text.charCodeAt(i), 16777619);
    b = Math.imul(b ^ text.charCodeAt(i), 3266489909);
  }
  return (a >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0") + (b >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}
function authoredShoulderGroundRevision(world, bounds2) {
  const triangles = [];
  for (const floor of world.floors) for (let i = 0; i < floor.indices.length; i += 3) {
    const vertices = floor.indices.slice(i, i + 3).map((index) => floor.vertices[index]), points = vertices.map((vertex) => vertex.point);
    if (Math.max(...points.map((p) => p.x)) < bounds2.min.x || Math.min(...points.map((p) => p.x)) > bounds2.max.x || Math.max(...points.map((p) => p.z)) < bounds2.min.z || Math.min(...points.map((p) => p.z)) > bounds2.max.z) continue;
    triangles.push([floor.id, floor.kind, vertices.map(physicalVertex)]);
  }
  return fingerprint2(triangles);
}
function authoredShoulderProfilePhysicalRevision(profile) {
  return fingerprint2({
    candidate: profile.candidate,
    source: profile.source,
    localGround: profile.localGround,
    boundary: profile.boundary,
    sourceDistrictId: profile.sourceDistrictId,
    clipFloorIds: profile.clipFloorIds,
    transferSiteIds: profile.transferSiteIds,
    district: { ...profile.district, floors: profile.district.floors.map(physicalFloor) },
    edges: profile.edges,
    triangleLineage: profile.triangleLineage
  });
}
function area3(poly) {
  return poly.length < 3 ? 0 : Math.abs(poly.reduce((sum, p, i) => {
    const q = poly[(i + 1) % poly.length];
    return sum + p.cell.x * q.cell.z - q.cell.x * p.cell.z;
  }, 0)) / 2;
}
var lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
var lerpPoint = (a, b, t) => ({ x: lerp(a.x, b.x, t), y: lerp(a.y, b.y, t), z: lerp(a.z, b.z, t) });
function half(poly, distance3) {
  const result = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < poly.length; i++) {
    const p = poly[i], q = poly[(i + 1) % poly.length], d = distance3(p.cell), e = distance3(q.cell);
    if (d >= -1e-12) result.push(p);
    if (d >= 0 !== e >= 0) {
      const t = d / (d - e);
      result.push({
        cell: { x: lerp(p.cell.x, q.cell.x, t), z: lerp(p.cell.z, q.cell.z, t) },
        point: lerpPoint(p.point, q.point, t),
        // Keep linear source interpolation through successive clips;
        // normalizing at each cut changes the original shading field.
        ...p.normal && q.normal ? { normal: lerpPoint(p.normal, q.normal, t) } : {}
      });
    }
  }
  return area3(result) > 1e-12 ? result : [];
}
function carve(poly, boundary) {
  let inside = [...poly];
  const outside = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < boundary.length; i++) {
    const p = boundary[i], q = boundary[(i + 1) % boundary.length];
    const distance3 = (c) => (q.x - p.x) * (c.z - p.z) - (q.z - p.z) * (c.x - p.x);
    const remainder = half(inside, (cell) => -distance3(cell));
    if (remainder.length) outside.push(remainder);
    inside = half(inside, distance3);
    if (!inside.length) break;
  }
  return { inside, outside };
}
function clipFloor(floor, boundary) {
  const vertices = [...floor.vertices], indices = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < floor.indices.length; i += 3) {
    const sourceIndices = floor.indices.slice(i, i + 3), result = carve(sourceIndices.map((index) => floor.vertices[index]), boundary);
    if (!result.inside.length) {
      indices.push(...sourceIndices);
      continue;
    }
    for (const poly of result.outside) {
      const offset = vertices.length;
      vertices.push(...poly);
      for (let j = 1; j + 1 < poly.length; j++) {
        if (area3([poly[0], poly[j], poly[j + 1]]) * 2 > 10001e-16) indices.push(offset, offset + j, offset + j + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  return { ...floor, vertices, indices };
}
function checkProfile(profile) {
  if (profile.version !== 1 || profile.candidate !== AUTHORED_SHOULDER_CANDIDATE || profile.source.baseSha256 !== BASE_SHA || profile.source.componentSha256 !== AUTHORED_SHOULDER_COMPONENT_SHA || profile.source.geometryProfileSha256 !== GEOMETRY_SHA) fail("source identity differs");
  if (profile.physicalRevision !== authoredShoulderProfilePhysicalRevision(profile)) fail("physical profile differs");
  const district = profile.district;
  if (district.id !== DISTRICT || district.turn !== 0 || district.logicalOrigin.x !== 0 || district.logicalOrigin.z !== 0 || Object.values(district.worldOrigin).some((value) => value !== 0) || district.floors.length !== 2 || district.floors.some((floor) => floor.kind !== "ground") || district.sites.length !== 19 || district.sites.filter((site) => site.placement).length !== 2 || profile.transferSiteIds.length !== 2 || profile.edges.length !== 36 || profile.edges.filter((edge) => edge.allows.length === 1 && edge.allows[0] === "walk").length !== 35)
    fail("diagnostic extension contract differs");
}
function composeAuthoredShoulderWorld(upstream, profile) {
  checkProfile(profile);
  if (upstream.definition.districts.some((district) => district.id === DISTRICT || district.id.startsWith("native05-cove-")))
    fail("requires immutable terrain without shoulder or cove");
  if (upstream.definition.source?.sha256 !== profile.source.baseSha256 || authoredShoulderGroundRevision(upstream, profile.localGround) !== profile.localGround.revision) fail("upstream physical locality differs");
  const source = upstream.definition.districts.find((district) => district.id === profile.sourceDistrictId) ?? fail("source district frame differs");
  if (source.turn !== 0 || source.logicalOrigin.x !== 0 || source.logicalOrigin.z !== 0 || Object.values(source.worldOrigin).some((value) => value !== 0) || profile.clipFloorIds.some((id) => !source.floors.some((floor) => floor.id === id))) fail("source district frame differs");
  const transfer = new Set(profile.transferSiteIds);
  for (const id of transfer) {
    const old = source.sites.find((site) => site.id === id), next = profile.district.sites.find((site) => site.id === id);
    if (!old || old.placement || !next?.placement || old.cell.x !== next.cell.x || old.cell.z !== next.cell.z) fail("new land must replace the audited walk-only site");
  }
  for (const site of upstream.sites.filter((site2) => site2.placement)) {
    const { x, z } = site.cell;
    const square = [[x - 0.46, z - 0.46], [x + 0.46, z - 0.46], [x + 0.46, z + 0.46], [x - 0.46, z + 0.46]].map(([x2, z2]) => ({ cell: { x: x2, z: z2 }, point: { x: x2, y: 0, z: z2 } }));
    if (area3(carve(square, profile.boundary).inside) > 1e-12) fail("replacement intersects an acquired footprint");
  }
  const definition2 = structuredClone(upstream.definition);
  definition2.districts = definition2.districts.map((district) => district.id !== source.id ? district : {
    ...district,
    floors: district.floors.map((floor) => profile.clipFloorIds.includes(floor.id) ? clipFloor(floor, profile.boundary) : floor),
    anchorFloors: district.anchorFloors ?? district.floors,
    sites: district.sites.filter((site) => !transfer.has(site.id)).map((site) => ({
      ...site,
      anchorPoint: site.anchorPoint ?? upstream.anchorAt(site.cell)
    }))
  });
  definition2.districts = [...definition2.districts, structuredClone(profile.district)];
  const mapRef = (ref) => ref.districtId === source.id && transfer.has(ref.siteId) ? { districtId: DISTRICT, siteId: ref.siteId } : ref;
  const oldEdges = definition2.edges.map((edge) => ({ ...edge, from: mapRef(edge.from), to: mapRef(edge.to) }));
  definition2.edges = oldEdges.map((edge) => ({ ...edge, allows: edge.allows.filter((passage) => passage !== "walk") })).filter((edge) => edge.allows.length);
  definition2.revision = `authored-shoulder:${profile.physicalRevision}`;
  const support = compileWorldDefinition(definition2), cells = new Map(support.sites.map((site) => [refKey4(site.ref), site.cell]));
  definition2.edges = oldEdges.map((edge) => ({ ...edge, allows: edge.allows.filter((passage) => passage !== "walk" || support.isWalkEdgeSupported(cells.get(refKey4(edge.from)), cells.get(refKey4(edge.to)))) })).filter((edge) => edge.allows.length);
  definition2.edges = [...definition2.edges, ...structuredClone(profile.edges)];
  definition2.revision = `authored-shoulder:${profile.physicalRevision}:${fingerprint2({ ...definition2, revision: void 0 })}`;
  const world = compileWorldDefinition(definition2);
  for (const site of upstream.sites.filter((site2) => site2.placement)) {
    if (JSON.stringify(world.anchorAt(site.cell)) !== JSON.stringify(site.point)) fail("acquired anchor changed");
    for (const dx of [-0.46, 0, 0.46]) for (const dz of [-0.46, 0, 0.46]) {
      const cell = { x: site.cell.x + dx, z: site.cell.z + dz };
      if (JSON.stringify(world.floorAt(cell)?.point) !== JSON.stringify(upstream.floorAt(cell)?.point)) fail("acquired support changed");
    }
  }
  return world;
}
